readme:
# Douyin DOU+ Talent Categories API

Retrieve the Douyin DOU+ talent category list to structure creator categorization without requiring any request parameters.

## Use cases

- Browse the official Douyin DOU+ talent category taxonomy.
- Populate category selector menus in talent discovery tools.
- Group Douyin creators by verified DOU+ content classifications.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/douyin/douplus/talent-categories" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'
```

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [Douyin DOU+ Promotable Items](/model/douyin/douplus/promotable-item-list): Returns the promotable video item list for a Douyin account on the DOU+ promotion page.
- [Douyin DOU+ User Search](/model/douyin/douplus/search-user): Searches for Douyin users in the DOU+ delivery context using a Douyin ID or nickname.
- [Douyin DOU+ Talents by Category](/model/douyin/douplus/talents-by-category): Returns a list of DOU+ talents filtered by category name or keyword.
